name: Continuity research index (current frontage lens)
intent: Current research-first visual treatment of the existing portal/feed frontage. Changes priority, density, and tone, not source ownership, A/B semantics, or systems architecture.

native_witnesses.observation: Homepage presents current/attention hero ahead of external feed and nested source tickers.
Rounded social-product cards, pills, and gray background coexist with already compact feed/source density.
Approved multi-domain and social-feed parent template with provenance and preserved source ownership.

comparison.A: Personal portal foregrounded by Keep the thread, identity, day/time; live research record appears below.
comparison.B: Research index foregrounded by work, source observations, compact reference navigation and subdued archival editorial type.
unknown: live provider availability and user-specific login state
authoritative researcher grouping until native report witnesses exist

design_constraints: No fake report counts, simulated live research, or invented claim merges
No new global A/B navigation taxonomy
Live feeds remain ephemeral and source lines remain distinct
Existing social-hub template remains approved beneath the new presentation
Narrow screen keeps the source index readable without sideways page scroll
